mapper.sql: m.id, m.room_id, m.sender_user_id, u.nickname AS sender_nickname, m.role, m.content, m.input_type, m.mode, m.visible_to_user_id, m.model, m.prompt_tokens, m.completion_tokens, m.created_at
FROM messages m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.sender_user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (room_id, sender_user_id, role, content, input_type, mode, visible_to_user_id, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderUserId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{inputType}, #{mode}, #{visibleToUserId}, #{model}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
